# omni_folder_permission (Resource)

Grants a content role on a folder to users or groups.

One resource per role. To give two groups different roles on the same folder, declare two resources. Changing `role` replaces the resource, because the role is part of its identity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omni_folder_permission" "analysts_view_finance" {
  folder_id = omni_folder.finance.id
  role      = "VIEWER"

  # Authoritative for this resource: a group removed from the set loses the
  # grant on the next apply.
  user_group_ids = [omni_user_group.analysts.id]
}

# One resource per role. Two groups with different roles on the same folder
# are two resources, because the role is part of this resource's identity and
# changing it forces a replacement.
resource "omni_folder_permission" "finance_team_edits_finance" {
  folder_id      = omni_folder.finance.id
  role           = "EDITOR"
  user_group_ids = [omni_user_group.finance_team.id]
}

# OWNER can only be granted to users, never to groups.
resource "omni_folder_permission" "finance_owner" {
  folder_id = omni_folder.finance.id
  role      = "OWNER"
  user_ids  = [omni_user.head_of_finance.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder_id` (String) The folder to grant access to.
- `role` (String) The content role to grant. One of `NO_ACCESS`, `VIEWER`, `EXPLORER`, `EDITOR`, `MANAGER` or `OWNER`. `OWNER` can only be granted to users, never to groups. These are content roles, which decide who can see and edit a folder or document. They are separate from model roles, which decide who can query data.

### Optional

- `access_boost` (Boolean) Whether to grant access boost alongside the role. Rejected with 403 when the organization has AccessBoost turned off.
- `user_group_ids` (Set of String) User group IDs granted this role. Authoritative for this resource. For embed, this is usually what you want: the `groups` claim in a signed URL resolves to these groups.

  Use the ID from `omni_user_group`, which is the SCIM miniUuid. Reading permissions back requires an extra lookup per group, because the permissions endpoint reports a group's full UUID instead and the two cannot be compared directly.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) User IDs granted this role. Authoritative for this resource: a user removed from the set has the grant revoked.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the form `<target id>:<role>`.
